## Key terms

{{< glossary personal-data sensitive-data confidential-information anonymize privacy-settings terms-of-use copyright academic-integrity plagiarism ai-use-statement responsible-ai-use >}}

## 23.1 Personal data in prompts

- **Personal data:** name with phone, e-mail, ID number, address, birthday.
- **Sensitive data:** health, salary, passwords, bank details.
- **Confidential information:** customer lists, contracts, exam questions.
- **Anonymize:** placeholders such as [Customer] or [amount].

![Keep these out of a prompt.](images/keep-out.png){width=100%}

![Anonymize before you paste.](images/anonymize.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/prompt-cleaner.html" poster="sims/prompt-cleaner.png" title="Prompt Cleaner: no personal data in the chat" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Anonymize **before** you paste; deleting the chat later is too late.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Clean three prompts"}
In **Prompt Cleaner**, clean the three prompts. Then rewrite one prompt of
your own with placeholders.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · What is it?"}
Use Prompt Cleaner. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="a placeholder|a font"}
a customer's name and address
:   personal data

a diagnosis in a sick note
:   sensitive data

the company's customer list
:   confidential information

"340 JD", once the name is replaced
:   can stay in the prompt
:::
:::

## 23.2 Settings, rules and copyright

- **Privacy settings:** chat history; training on your chats.
- **Rules:** allowed tool? work account? **terms of use**?
- **Copyright in:** upload only what you may share.
- **Copyright out:** AI output can be close to existing works.

![Check the settings and the rules.](images/settings.png){width=100%}

![Copyright and AI.](images/copyright-ai.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
AI output is not automatically free to use: the terms and the law decide.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Check one tool"}
In an AI tool you use, check the chat history, training, your account, and
one sentence of the terms of use.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Settings and copyright"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="a bigger screen|a new password"}
"use my chats to improve the model"
:   a privacy setting

the rules you accept when you use a tool
:   the terms of use

reworking a paid e-book with AI
:   not allowed without permission

the account to use at work
:   the work account
:::
:::

## 23.3 Honesty and the AI-use statement

- **Academic integrity:** your own work, correct sources, the course rules.
- **Plagiarism:** AI text handed in as your own.
- **AI-use statement:** tool, used for, what you changed, how you checked.

![Honest AI use.](images/honesty.png){width=100%}

![An AI-use statement.](images/ai-statement.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/statement-builder.html" poster="sims/statement-builder.png" title="Statement Builder: say how you used AI" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"AI was used" is not enough: say for what, and how you checked it.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Your statement"}
In **Statement Builder**, make all five checks green. Then write a statement
for a piece of your own work.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Honest use"}
Use Statement Builder. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="hide it|delete your drafts"}
AI text handed in as your own
:   plagiarism

AI explains a topic, you write your own notes
:   usually fine

the four parts of a statement
:   tool, use, changes, checks

what shows your own work
:   your drafts and prompts
:::
:::

## 23.4 A routine for responsible AI use

1. Remove personal data.
2. Check the rules.
3. Respect copyright.
4. Check the output.
5. State the use.

![Five steps.](images/five-steps.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A short e-mail with a customer's name also needs step 1.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Five steps"}
Apply the five steps to one AI task of your own: one sentence per step.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · The steps"}
Choose the step.

::: {.match extra="buy a faster PC|use capital letters"}
replace the customer's name with [Customer]
:   remove personal data

read the terms of the image tool
:   check the rules

check the numbers in two sources
:   check the output

"Image made with an AI tool."
:   state the use
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Responsible or Not? {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six cases: a **salary list**, a whole **AI essay**, an **AI poster**, a
**paid e-book**, **learning** a hard topic, and a tool that **trains** on
customer complaints.

{{< sim file="sims/responsible-or-not.html" poster="sims/responsible-or-not.png" title="Responsible or Not? Six people, six AI tasks" kind="game" height="480" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The cases"}
Choose the best action.

::: {.match extra="paste it all|hand it in"}
a salary list with names
:   anonymize or use an approved tool

a whole essay written by AI
:   write it yourself and state any help

a paid e-book for a company guide
:   ask the owner or write your own

a tool that trains on chats
:   switch off training and anonymize
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Keep personal, sensitive and confidential data out of prompts:
  anonymize.
- Check the privacy settings, the rules and the terms of use.
- Respect copyright in what you upload and in what you use.
- Honest use: your own work, and an AI-use statement.
- Five steps make responsible AI use a habit.
